# RaceLab — API Contract

This document is the single source of truth for the HTTP contract between the
**Angular frontend**, the **NestJS BFF** and the **Spring Boot backend**.

* The frontend only talks to the BFF (`/api/**`), served through Nginx on the same origin.
* The BFF forwards `/api/**` to the backend unchanged (same paths, same payloads).
* Header `X-RaceLab-Instance: primary | secondary` (optional) makes the BFF route the request
  to a specific backend instance (distributed profile). Default: `primary`.
* Header `X-Correlation-Id` is generated by the BFF when absent and propagated to the backend,
  echoed in every response and in every error body.
* All timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC strings. Monetary values are JSON numbers produced from
  `BigDecimal` (2 decimal places).

## Enumerations

| Enum | Values |
|---|---|
| `Category` | `CONCURRENCY`, `ISOLATION`, `LOCKING`, `DISTRIBUTED` |
| `Difficulty` | `BEGINNER`, `INTERMEDIATE`, `ADVANCED` |
| `StrategyType` | `NONE`, `OPTIMISTIC_LOCKING`, `PESSIMISTIC_LOCKING`, `ATOMIC_UPDATE`, `ATOMIC_UNGUARDED`, `SERIALIZABLE`, `JAVA_SYNCHRONIZED`, `REENTRANT_LOCK`, `ADVISORY_LOCK`, `REDIS_LOCK`, `FENCING_TOKEN`, `UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY`, `LOCK_ORDERING`, `ATOMIC_CLAIM`, `SKIP_LOCKED`, `OUTBOX`, `OUTBOX_NAIVE_CONSUMER`, `ISOLATION_LEVEL` |
| `IsolationLevel` | `READ_UNCOMMITTED`, `READ_COMMITTED`, `REPEATABLE_READ`, `SERIALIZABLE` |
| `ExecutionMode` | `CONCURRENT`, `STEP_BY_STEP` |
| `Topology` | `SINGLE_JVM`, `DISTRIBUTED` |
| `FailureMode` | `NONE`, `CRASH_AFTER_COMMIT`, `CRASH_BEFORE_COMMIT`, `RELAY_CRASH_BEFORE_ACK` |
| `ExperimentStatus` | `CREATED`, `RUNNING`, `COMPLETED`, `FAILED`, `CANCELLED` |
| `EventSource` | `INSTRUMENTED` (emitted by application code), `DATABASE_OBSERVED` (read from PostgreSQL: `pg_blocking_pids`, `pg_stat_activity`, SQLSTATE, error detail) |
| `TxStatus` | `COMMITTED`, `ROLLED_BACK`, `REJECTED`, `FAILED`, `CANCELLED` |
| `ErrorType` | `DEADLOCK`, `SERIALIZATION_FAILURE`, `OPTIMISTIC_LOCK`, `LOCK_TIMEOUT`, `UNIQUE_VIOLATION`, `TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT`, `CONNECTION_FAILURE`, `CANCELLED`, `BUSINESS_RULE`, `LOCK_NOT_ACQUIRED`, `INJECTED_FAULT`, `INTERNAL` |
| `Severity` | `LOW`, `MEDIUM`, `HIGH`, `CRITICAL` |

### Event types

```
EXPERIMENT_CREATED  EXPERIMENT_STARTED  DATA_PREPARED  TRANSACTION_STARTED
READ_STARTED READ_COMPLETED VALIDATION_STARTED VALIDATION_COMPLETED
LOCK_REQUESTED LOCK_ACQUIRED LOCK_WAITING LOCK_RELEASED
WRITE_STARTED WRITE_COMPLETED COMMIT_STARTED COMMIT_COMPLETED
ROLLBACK_STARTED ROLLBACK_COMPLETED
DEADLOCK_DETECTED OPTIMISTIC_LOCK_CONFLICT SERIALIZATION_FAILURE
RETRY_SCHEDULED INCONSISTENCY_DETECTED
CHECKPOINT_REACHED CHECKPOINT_RELEASED
MESSAGE_PUBLISHED MESSAGE_CONSUMED FAULT_INJECTED
EXPERIMENT_COMPLETED EXPERIMENT_FAILED EXPERIMENT_CANCELLED
```

Timeline colour mapping (frontend): READ_* blue, WRITE_* purple, LOCK_WAITING/LOCK_REQUESTED/CHECKPOINT_* yellow,
DEADLOCK/OPTIMISTIC/SERIALIZATION/INCONSISTENCY orange, COMMIT_* green, ROLLBACK_* red, others grey.

## Catalog

### `GET /api/scenarios` → `ScenarioDescriptor[]`
### `GET /api/scenarios/{id}` → `ScenarioDescriptor`

```json
{
  "id": "bank-withdrawal",
  "name": "Concurrent withdrawals",
  "category": "CONCURRENCY",
  "description": "…",
  "businessContext": "…",
  "invariant": "initial balance − confirmed withdrawals = final balance ∧ balance ≥ 0",
  "supportedStrategies": ["NONE", "OPTIMISTIC_LOCKING", "…"],
  "defaultStrategy": "NONE",
  "supportsStepMode": true,
  "supportsDistributed": true,
  "relevantParameters": ["threads", "transactions", "initialValue", "operationValue", "…"],
  "parameterLabels": { "initialValue": "Initial balance (BRL)", "operationValue": "Withdrawal amount (BRL)" },
  "templates": [ { "code": "ACC-A", "label": "Conta A — R$ 1.000,00" } ],
  "defaults": { /* ExperimentConfiguration */ }
}
```

### `GET /api/catalog` → `ExperimentPreset[]`

```json
{
  "id": "lost-update",
  "name": "Lost Update",
  "category": "CONCURRENCY",
  "difficulty": "BEGINNER",
  "problem": "…",
  "businessScenario": "…",
  "scenarioId": "bank-withdrawal",
  "strategy": "NONE",
  "availableStrategies": ["NONE", "OPTIMISTIC_LOCKING", "…"],
  "configuration": { /* full ExperimentConfiguration (defaults + overrides) */ },
  "expectedResult": "…",
  "explanation": "…",
  "recommendations": ["…"],
  "demo": 1,
  "tags": ["money", "lost-update"]
}
```
`demo` is the demo number (1..8) when the preset is one of the README demo shortcuts, otherwise `null`.

### `GET /api/strategies` → `StrategyDescriptor[]`

```json
{ "id": "OPTIMISTIC_LOCKING", "name": "Optimistic Locking", "family": "OPTIMISTIC",
  "scope": "DATABASE", "description": "…", "advantages": ["…"], "limitations": ["…"] }
```

## ExperimentConfiguration

```json
{
  "threads": 2, "transactions": 2,
  "initialValue": 1000.00, "operationValue": 800.00,
  "resourceCount": 1, "resourceCode": "ACC-A",
  "delayBeforeReadMs": 0, "delayAfterReadMs": 0, "delayBeforeWriteMs": 0, "delayBeforeCommitMs": 0,
  "isolationLevel": "READ_COMMITTED",
  "transactionTimeoutMs": 10000, "lockTimeoutMs": 5000,
  "retries": 0, "backoffMs": 100, "seed": 42,
  "executionMode": "CONCURRENT", "topology": "SINGLE_JVM", "coordinated": true,
  "lockTtlMs": 1500, "failureMode": "NONE", "stepTimeoutSeconds": 120
}
```

Limits (validated by frontend **and** backend; backend returns 400 on violation):
`threads 1..16`, `transactions 1..200` (and `>= 1`), `resourceCount 1..20`, delays `0..5000`,
`transactionTimeoutMs 1000..60000`, `lockTimeoutMs 100..30000`, `retries 0..10`, `backoffMs 0..5000`,
`lockTtlMs 200..30000`, `stepTimeoutSeconds 10..600`, `initialValue 0..1_000_000`, `operationValue 0.01..1_000_000`.
Max 3 experiments running concurrently per backend instance (409 `TOO_MANY_EXPERIMENTS`).

## Experiments

### `POST /api/experiments`
```json
{ "presetId": "lost-update", "scenarioId": "bank-withdrawal", "strategy": "NONE",
  "name": "optional", "configuration": { /* partial; missing fields use scenario defaults */ },
  "autoStart": false }
```
→ `201 ExperimentDetails`. Recommended client flow: create (`autoStart:false`) → open SSE → `POST /start`.

### `GET /api/experiments?page=0&size=20&category=&status=&scenarioId=&strategy=` → `Page<ExperimentDetails>`
```json
{ "content": [ /* ExperimentDetails */ ], "page": 0, "size": 20, "totalElements": 57, "totalPages": 3 }
```

### `GET /api/experiments/{id}` → `ExperimentDetails`
```json
{
  "id": "EXP-7F3A9C21", "name": "Lost Update", "presetId": "lost-update",
  "scenarioId": "bank-withdrawal", "category": "CONCURRENCY", "strategy": "NONE",
  "status": "COMPLETED", "executionMode": "CONCURRENT", "instanceId": "primary",
  "comparisonId": null, "warmup": false, "rerunOf": null,
  "createdAt": "…", "startedAt": "…", "finishedAt": "…", "durationMs": 412,
  "consistent": false, "violationCount": 1, "eventCount": 38,
  "configuration": { /* ExperimentConfiguration */ },
  "errorMessage": null,
  "stepState": {
    "active": true,
    "pending": [ { "workerId": "worker-1", "step": "read", "description": "Read balance of ACC-A", "arrivedAt": "…" } ],
    "blocked": [ { "workerId": "worker-2", "reason": "Waiting for row lock (observed: blocked by pid 4711)" } ],
    "suggestedWorkerId": "worker-1",
    "deadline": "…"
  }
}
```
`stepState` is `null` unless `executionMode = STEP_BY_STEP` and the experiment is running.

### Lifecycle
| Method | Path | Body | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/experiments/{id}/start` | – | `ExperimentDetails` |
| POST | `/api/experiments/{id}/step` | `{ "workerId": "worker-2" }` (optional; default = oldest pending) | `ExperimentDetails` |
| POST | `/api/experiments/{id}/resume` | – | leaves step mode, releases all checkpoints |
| POST | `/api/experiments/{id}/cancel` | – | cancels cooperatively; DB backends are cancelled with `pg_cancel_backend` |
| POST | `/api/experiments/{id}/rerun` | `{ "autoStart": false }` | new `ExperimentDetails` (new id, isolated data) |
| DELETE | `/api/experiments/{id}` | – | `204` (deletes history **and** the experiment's namespaced data) |

### Events
`GET /api/experiments/{id}/events` with `Accept: text/event-stream` → SSE stream.
`GET /api/experiments/{id}/events` with `Accept: application/json` → `ExperimentEvent[]` (persisted events).

SSE frames:
```
id: 12
event: experiment-event
data: { /* ExperimentEvent */ }

event: heartbeat
data: {"timestamp":"…"}

event: end
data: {"status":"COMPLETED"}
```
* `Last-Event-ID` header (or `?lastEventId=` query param) → server replays events with `sequence > lastEventId`.
* The stream ends (`end` event, then connection closed) after the terminal event has been delivered.
* Clients must deduplicate by `sequence`.

```json
{
  "experimentId": "EXP-7F3A9C21", "sequence": 12,
  "transactionId": "tx-w2-1", "workerId": "worker-2", "threadName": "rl-EXP-7F3A9C21-worker-2",
  "instanceId": "primary", "correlationId": "…", "connectionPid": 4711,
  "eventType": "READ_COMPLETED", "resource": "account:ACC-A",
  "timestamp": "2026-01-01T14:30:00Z", "elapsedTimeMs": 350,
  "source": "INSTRUMENTED", "message": "Read balance 1000.00 (version 0)",
  "details": { "balance": 1000.00, "version": 0 }
}
```

### Results
| Path | Payload |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/experiments/{id}/result` | `ExperimentResult` (404 `RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE` while running) |
| `GET /api/experiments/{id}/metrics` | `Metrics` |
| `GET /api/experiments/{id}/transactions` | `TransactionOutcome[]` |
| `GET /api/experiments/{id}/violations` | `Violation[]` |
| `GET /api/experiments/{id}/recommendations` | `Recommendation[]` |
| `GET /api/experiments/{id}/export?format=json\|csv\|markdown\|pdf` | file download |

```json
// ExperimentResult
{
  "experimentId": "…", "status": "COMPLETED", "consistent": false,
  "summary": "Lost update: 2 withdrawals confirmed (1600.00) but balance only decreased by 800.00",
  "initialState": [ResourceState], "finalState": [ResourceState],
  "stateRows": [ { "resource": "account:ACC-A", "label": "Conta A", "attribute": "balance",
                   "initial": "1000.00", "actual": "200.00", "expected": "-600.00", "ok": false } ],
  "transactions": [TransactionOutcome], "violations": [Violation],
  "observations": [Observation], "metrics": Metrics,
  "recommendations": [Recommendation], "lockGraph": LockGraph | null,
  "environment": { "postgresVersion": "PostgreSQL 17.x", "instanceId": "primary", "javaVersion": "25", "…": "…" }
}

// ResourceState
{ "resource": "account:ACC-A", "label": "Conta A", "type": "ACCOUNT", "attributes": { "balance": 1000.00, "version": 0 } }

// TransactionOutcome
{ "workerId": "worker-1", "transactionId": "tx-w1-1", "instanceId": "primary", "status": "COMMITTED",
  "attempts": 1, "latencyMs": 120, "lockWaitMs": 0, "sqlState": null, "errorType": null,
  "message": null, "friendlyMessage": null, "expectedFailure": false,
  "before": { "balance": 1000.00 }, "after": { "balance": 200.00 }, "details": { "amount": 800.00 } }

// Violation
{ "kind": "BUSINESS_INVARIANT", "rule": "initial − withdrawals = final", "description": "…",
  "expected": "-600.00", "actual": "200.00", "difference": "800.00", "transactions": ["tx-w1-1","tx-w2-1"],
  "severity": "CRITICAL", "possibleCause": "…", "recommendedStrategies": ["ATOMIC_UPDATE", "OPTIMISTIC_LOCKING"] }

// Observation (isolation experiments)
{ "phenomenon": "NON_REPEATABLE_READ", "isolationLevel": "READ_COMMITTED", "effectiveIsolationLevel": "READ_COMMITTED",
  "reproduced": true, "outcome": "First read 1000.00, second read 500.00 in the same transaction",
  "values": { "firstRead": 1000.00, "secondRead": 500.00 }, "note": "…" }

// Metrics
{ "totalTimeMs": 412, "avgLatencyMs": 201.5, "p50LatencyMs": 198, "p95LatencyMs": 230, "maxLatencyMs": 230,
  "throughputTps": 4.85, "transactionsStarted": 2, "attempts": 2, "committed": 2, "rolledBack": 0,
  "businessRejections": 0, "conflicts": 0, "deadlocks": 0, "serializationFailures": 0,
  "optimisticConflicts": 0, "uniqueViolations": 0, "lockTimeouts": 0, "retries": 0,
  "lockWaitTimeMs": 0, "inconsistencies": 1 }

// Recommendation
{ "id": "lost-update-optimistic", "title": "…", "trigger": "Lost update detected", "justification": "…",
  "benefits": ["…"], "tradeOffs": ["…"], "strategies": ["OPTIMISTIC_LOCKING"], "priority": 1 }

// LockGraph
{ "source": "DATABASE_REPORTED" | "DATABASE_OBSERVED" | "RECONSTRUCTED", "description": "…", "cycle": true,
  "nodes": [ { "id": "pid:4711", "kind": "TRANSACTION" | "LOCK", "label": "worker-1 (pid 4711)",
               "workerId": "worker-1", "pid": 4711, "victim": false } ],
  "edges": [ { "from": "pid:4711", "to": "lock:tx:812", "label": "waits for ShareLock" } ] }
```

## Comparisons

### `POST /api/comparisons`
```json
{ "name": "optional", "scenarioId": "bank-withdrawal",
  "strategies": ["NONE","OPTIMISTIC_LOCKING","PESSIMISTIC_LOCKING","ATOMIC_UPDATE","SERIALIZABLE"],
  "configuration": { /* partial */ }, "repetitions": 3, "warmupRuns": 1 }
```
Limits: 2..8 strategies, repetitions 1..10, warmupRuns 0..3. → `201 Comparison`.

### `GET /api/comparisons` → `Comparison[]` (latest first) · `GET /api/comparisons/{id}` → `Comparison`
```json
{
  "id": "CMP-1A2B3C4D", "name": "…", "scenarioId": "bank-withdrawal", "status": "RUNNING",
  "strategies": ["…"], "configuration": { }, "repetitions": 3, "warmupRuns": 1,
  "progress": { "completedRuns": 4, "totalRuns": 20, "currentStrategy": "OPTIMISTIC_LOCKING" },
  "createdAt": "…", "finishedAt": null,
  "results": [ {
    "strategy": "NONE", "experimentIds": ["EXP-…"], "measuredRuns": 3,
    "metrics": { /* Metrics averaged over measured runs */ },
    "consistentRuns": 0, "inconsistentRuns": 3, "consistencyPreserved": false,
    "finalStateRows": [ /* stateRows of the last measured run */ ]
  } ],
  "disclaimer": "Results depend on hardware, database configuration, load and scenario…"
}
```
`POST /api/comparisons/{id}/cancel` cancels a running comparison.

## Code examples
### `GET /api/code-examples/{scenarioId}/{strategy}`
```json
{
  "scenarioId": "bank-withdrawal", "strategy": "ATOMIC_UPDATE",
  "java": [ { "title": "Atomic conditional update", "source": "BankWithdrawalExperiment.java", "language": "java", "code": "…" } ],
  "sql":  [ { "title": "…", "source": "…", "language": "sql", "code": "…" } ],
  "baseline": { "strategy": "NONE", "java": [ … ], "sql": [ … ] },
  "typescript": { "title": "Start this experiment from TypeScript", "source": "generated", "language": "typescript", "code": "…" },
  "configuration": { /* default ExperimentConfiguration */ },
  "explanation": "…", "advantages": ["…"], "limitations": ["…"]
}
```
Snippets are extracted at build time from the real backend source (`// @snippet:start …` markers), so they always match what runs.

```json
              "versionConflicts": 3, "avgDurationMs": 410.2, "successRate": 0.83, "running": 0 },

```
All dashboard numbers are aggregated from persisted experiments; there is no demo data.

## Errors
Every non-2xx response:
```json
{ "timestamp": "…", "status": 400, "error": "Bad Request", "code": "VALIDATION_FAILED",
  "message": "threads must be between 1 and 16", "details": ["threads: must be less than or equal to 16"],
  "correlationId": "…", "path": "/api/experiments" }
```
Codes: `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `NOT_FOUND`, `RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE`, `INVALID_STATE`, `TOO_MANY_EXPERIMENTS`,
`UNSUPPORTED_STRATEGY`, `PEER_UNAVAILABLE`, `REDIS_UNAVAILABLE`, `RATE_LIMITED`, `BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE` (BFF),
`BACKEND_TIMEOUT` (BFF), `INTERNAL_ERROR`.
